summary.zh: 消息、日历、云文档与邮箱
summary.en: Messages, calendar, docs, and mail

description.zh:
通过官方 lark-cli 读写飞书消息、日历、云文档、云空间、邮箱与任务。
在插件页面安装 CLI、连接账号并管理应用权限。
description.en:
Read and send Feishu messages, manage calendar events, cloud docs, drive files, mail, and tasks through the official lark-cli.
Install the CLI and connect your account on the plugin page.

summary.zh: 课表、成绩、考试、公告与请假
summary.en: Timetable, grades, exams, notices, and leave requests

description.zh: 查询课表、成绩、学分、考试、公告、空闲教室与请假记录；账号密码只在插件页使用
description.en:
Query timetable, grades, credits, exams, notices, free classrooms, and leave records with the Node.js academic affairs CLI inside the Linux runtime.
Sign-in and credentials are handled on the plugin page, and the CLI installs automatically on first use.

summary.zh: 读取小米云笔记、待办、相册与短信
summary.en: Notes, tasks, photos, and SMS from Mi Cloud

description.zh:
连接小米账号后读取小米云服务中的笔记、待办、短信、联系人、相册与录音。
首次使用需在插件页面完成小米账号登录。
description.en:
Connect a Xiaomi account to read notes, tasks, SMS, contacts, photos, and recordings from Mi Cloud.
Sign in to your Xiaomi account on the plugin page first.

summary.zh: 消息、邮件、文档、日程与待办
summary.en: Messages, mail, docs, schedules, and tasks

description.zh:
安装官方 wecom-cli 后扫码授权，操作企业微信的消息、邮件、文档、日程与待办。
账号授权与 CLI 安装都在插件页面完成。
description.en:
Scan the QR code to authorize the official wecom-cli, then work with WeCom messages, mail, docs, schedules, and tasks.
CLI install and account authorization both happen on the plugin page.

summary.zh: 动手实现前先梳理需求与方案
summary.en: Shape the idea before writing code

description.zh:
在开始写代码或做任何创作前，用对话把需求、约束与可选方案梳理清楚。
产出经过确认的设计，再进入实现。
适合新功能、组件、行为改动或任何从零开始的计划。
description.en:
Use a guided conversation to clarify requirements, constraints, and options before any creative work.
Confirm a direction first, then move into implementation.
Great for new features, components, behavior changes, or any plan from scratch.

summary.zh: 把零散信息整理成规范 issue
summary.en: Turn scattered notes into a clean issue

description.zh:
把错误日志、语音记录或截图整理成结构清晰的 GitHub issue。
支持附图与 GIF 作为证据，适合从非正式描述快速建单。
description.en:
Turn error logs, voice notes, or screenshots into a well-structured GitHub issue.
Supports images and GIFs as evidence, making it fast to file a clear issue.

summary.zh: 构建高质量 MCP 服务器的指南
summary.en: Guide to building quality MCP servers

description.zh:
面向 Python(FastMCP)、Node/TypeScript 与 C#/.NET 的 MCP 服务器开发指南。
覆盖工具设计、评估、最佳实践与多语言模板，适合把外部 API 接入助手。
description.en:
A guide to building MCP servers in Python (FastMCP), Node/TypeScript, and C#/.NET.
Covers tool design, evaluation, best practices, and templates for exposing external APIs to assistants.

summary.zh: 创建与更新技能的规范与脚手架
summary.en: Patterns and scaffolding for creating skills

description.zh:
为 AI 编码助手创建高质量技能：结构、输出模式与工作流。
侧重 Azure SDK 与 Microsoft Foundry 场景，含初始化、打包与校验脚本。
description.en:
Create high-quality skills for AI coding agents: structure, output patterns, and workflows.
Focused on Azure SDK and Microsoft Foundry scenarios, with init, package, and validation scripts.

summary.zh: 用可复现的流程定位 bug 根因
summary.en: Trace bugs to their root cause

description.zh:
遇到 bug、测试失败或意外行为时，先建立可复现证据，再沿调用链追到根因。
强调先改测试复现、再做最小修复，避免拍脑袋改代码。
description.en:
When a bug, failing test, or unexpected behavior shows up, reproduce it first, then trace the call chain to the root cause.
Emphasizes a failing test followed by the smallest fix instead of guessing.

summary.zh: 先写测试再写实现
summary.en: Write the test before the code

description.zh:
在写实现代码前先写会失败的测试，用红-绿-重构推进功能与修复。
包含如何写出好的测试与常见反模式。
适合任何新功能或 bug 修复。
description.en:
Write a failing test first, then implement, using red-green-refactor for features and fixes.
Covers how to write good tests and common anti-patterns.
Works for any new feature or bug fix.

summary.zh: 声称完成前先跑验证并给出证据
summary.en: Run the checks before claiming done

description.zh:
在说「做完了/修好了/测试通过」之前，先运行验证命令并核对输出。
要求用证据代替断言，避免未经验证的完成声明。
description.en:
Before saying done, fixed, or passing, run the verification commands and check the output.
Evidence before assertions: never claim success without running it.

summary.zh: 把需求拆成可执行的步骤
summary.en: Turn requirements into executable steps

description.zh:
当需求已明确但改动跨多个步骤时，先写出分阶段、可验证的实施计划。
计划包含任务拆分、顺序与每步的验证方式，再开始动代码。
description.en:
When requirements are clear but the change spans multiple steps, write a staged, verifiable plan first.
Plans cover task breakdown, ordering, and how to verify each step before code changes.

summary.zh: 读写 Airtable 数据库与记录
summary.en: Read and write Airtable bases and records

description.zh:
连接 Airtable 作为数据库与操作层，查询、创建和更新记录。
适合把表格数据接入对话流程。
description.en:
Use Airtable as a database and operations layer: query, create, and update records.
Good for bringing table data into the conversation.

authHint.zh: 首次连接需在浏览器登录 Airtable 并授权。
authHint.en: Sign in to Airtable in the browser and authorize on first connect.

summary.zh: 调用万级爬虫与自动化工具
summary.en: Run scrapers and automations from Apify

description.zh:
从 Apify Store 调用现成的爬虫、抓取器与自动化工具提取网站数据。
连接时需要 Apify API Token。
description.en:
Call ready-made scrapers, crawlers, and automation tools from Apify Store to extract website data.
Requires an Apify API token.

authHint.zh: 需要 Apify API Token，连接时按提示填写。
authHint.en: Requires an Apify API token; you'll be asked for it when connecting.

summary.zh: 搜索与管理 Jira、Confluence、Loom
summary.en: Search and manage Jira, Confluence, and Loom

description.zh:
通过 Atlassian Rovo MCP 搜索、创建和管理 Jira、Confluence、Loom 等工作内容。
首次连接需使用 Atlassian 账号完成 OAuth 授权。
description.en:
Search, create, and manage Jira issues, Confluence pages, Loom videos, and more via Atlassian Rovo MCP.
Sign in with your Atlassian account to authorize on first connect.

authHint.zh: 首次连接需在浏览器登录 Atlassian 并授权。
authHint.en: Sign in to Atlassian in the browser and authorize on first connect.

summary.zh: 创建、搜索、编辑与导出设计
summary.en: Create, search, edit, and export designs

description.zh:
在 Canva 中创建、搜索、编辑设计，并导出设计资源。
适合生成海报、社媒图与演示文稿素材。
description.en:
Create, search, and edit designs in Canva, then export the results.
Handy for posters, social images, and presentation assets.

authHint.zh: 首次连接需在浏览器登录 Canva 并授权。
authHint.en: Sign in to Canva in the browser and authorize on first connect.

summary.zh: 检索 Cloudflare 文档与 API 说明
summary.en: Search Cloudflare docs and API references

description.zh:
提供 Cloudflare 官方文档检索工具，帮助查询产品说明与 API 用法。
公开服务，无需账号即可连接。
description.en:
Search the official Cloudflare documentation for product guides and API usage.
Public service: no account needed.

summary.zh: 获取库与框架的最新文档和代码示例
summary.en: Up-to-date library docs and code examples

description.zh:
根据库名与版本检索最新文档，返回可直接使用的代码示例。
公开服务，适合在写代码前确认 API 用法。
description.en:
Look up current documentation by library and version, with examples you can use directly.
Public service, handy for confirming API usage before writing code.

summary.zh: 把设计稿、组件与变量接入对话
summary.en: Bring designs, components, and variables into the conversation

description.zh:
读取 Figma 文件中的设计上下文，包括组件、样式与变量。
适合在实现界面前获取准确的设计信息。
description.en:
Read design context from Figma files, including components, styles, and variables.
Useful for getting accurate design details before building UI.

authHint.zh: 首次连接需在浏览器登录 Figma 并授权。
authHint.en: Sign in to Figma in the browser and authorize on first connect.

summary.zh: 网页搜索、抓取与结构化提取
summary.en: Web search, scraping, and structured extraction

description.zh:
搜索网页、抓取页面内容并提取结构化数据。
也可检索论文并抓取多页面站点；公开访问，可选填 Firecrawl API Key。
description.en:
Search the web, scrape page content, and extract structured data.
Also supports paper search and multi-page crawling; public access with an optional Firecrawl API key.

authHint.zh: 公开访问；可选填 Firecrawl API Key。
authHint.en: Public access; Firecrawl API key optional.

summary.zh: 查询与管理 Linear 项目、issue 与文档
summary.en: Find and manage Linear issues, projects, and docs

description.zh:
在 Linear 工作区中查找 issue、项目和文档，也能创建与更新条目。
适合开发团队在对话里跟进任务进度。
description.en:
Look up issues, projects, and documents in your Linear workspace, and create or update them.
A good fit for development teams tracking work in the conversation.

authHint.zh: 首次连接需在浏览器登录 Linear 并授权。
authHint.en: Sign in to Linear in the browser and authorize on first connect.

summary.zh: 管理 Neon 项目、分支与 Postgres 数据库
summary.en: Manage Neon projects, branches, and Postgres databases

description.zh:
通过官方 MCP 管理 Neon 项目、分支与 Lakebase Postgres 数据库。
可以创建分支、查看连接串并执行 SQL。
description.en:
Manage Neon projects, branches, and Lakebase Postgres databases through the official MCP server.
Create branches, read connection strings, and run SQL.

authHint.zh: 首次连接需在浏览器登录 Neon 并授权。
authHint.en: Sign in to Neon in the browser and authorize on first connect.

summary.zh: 搜索与编辑 Notion 页面、数据库
summary.en: Search and edit Notion pages and databases

description.zh:
连接 Notion 工作区，搜索页面并按需创建或更新内容。
适合把会议记录、知识库与项目资料接入对话。
description.en:
Connect your Notion workspace to search pages and create or update content on demand.
Useful for bringing meeting notes, knowledge bases, and project docs into the conversation.

authHint.zh: 首次连接需在浏览器登录 Notion 并授权。
authHint.en: Sign in to Notion in the browser and authorize on first connect.

summary.zh: 实时网页搜索与研究
summary.en: Real-time web search and research

description.zh:
通过 Perplexity API 做实时网页搜索、推理与研究，返回带来源的答案。
连接时需要 Perplexity API Key。
description.en:
Run real-time web search, reasoning, and research through the Perplexity API, with answers that cite sources.
Requires a Perplexity API key.

authHint.zh: 需要 Perplexity API Key，连接时按提示填写。
authHint.en: Requires a Perplexity API key; you'll be asked for it when connecting.

summary.zh: 产品分析、功能开关与实验数据
summary.en: Product analytics, feature flags, and experiments

description.zh:
查询 PostHog 的产品分析、功能开关、实验与错误数据。
连接时需要 PostHog API Token。
description.en:
Query PostHog product analytics, feature flags, experiments, and error data.
Requires a PostHog API token.

authHint.zh: 需要 PostHog API Token，连接时按提示填写。
authHint.en: Requires a PostHog API token; you'll be asked for it when connecting.

summary.zh: 管理客户、商品、支付与发票
summary.en: Manage customers, products, payments, and invoices

description.zh:
通过 Stripe 官方 MCP 管理客户、商品、支付与发票等数据。
连接时需要提供 Stripe API Key，请按服务提示授权。
description.en:
Manage customers, products, payments, and invoices through Stripe's official MCP server.
You'll need a Stripe API key; follow the prompt to authorize the connection.

authHint.zh: 需要 Stripe API Key，连接时按提示填写。
authHint.en: Requires a Stripe API key; you'll be asked for it when connecting.

summary.zh: 连接 9000+ 应用与 4 万+ 自动化动作
summary.en: Connect 9,000+ apps and 40,000+ actions

description.zh:
通过 Zapier 把助手连接到 9,000 多个应用，执行 40,000 多种自动化动作。
首次连接需在浏览器登录 Zapier 并完成授权。
description.en:
Connect the assistant to 9,000+ apps and run 40,000+ actions through Zapier.
Sign in to Zapier in the browser and authorize on first connect.

authHint.zh: 首次连接需在浏览器登录 Zapier 并授权。
authHint.en: Sign in to Zapier in the browser and authorize on first connect.
